evidence: Local verifier isolation has a concrete artifact-root symlink bypass, with hosted reachability still unmeasured. task/task.toml:2 transfers both /app and /assets; tests/test.sh:72-83 rejects /app symlinks but does not validate /assets, then line 88 runs `chmod -R a+rX /assets`. If /assets itself is a symlink to /tests, that command reverses the private permissions established at lines 10-12 and tests/Dockerfile:43-44. The hash-verified raw isolation-results.json ordinary_assets control records /tests mode 0700, all three rubric reads denied with EACCES, reward writes denied, UID/GID 65534, only DB_PATH/HOME/NODE_PATH/PATH/PORT in the app environment, no synthetic secret inherited, and a successful SQLite write. Its assets_symlink case records /tests mode 0755 and successful reads of scoring.toml, scored/functional/judge.toml and gates/render/judge.toml from the same unprivileged app; direct reward writes and credential reads remain denied. This is a criteria-confidentiality failure, not a demonstrated forged reward or real-key exposure. Raw artifact SHA256 values were recomputed and match the current raw index: isolation-results.json cc8892bd653a8a5039c526e063e8cef19efaa9d9eb34c6de55ee421d234eb194; container_driver.py c5171319330dc559aad19c7d892263610c2dbfbea886f8bb91c7b01c52b405f3; isolation_driver.py 92253149cf6c2521559b70ec1a500226c666fb8da33c34283a0a5dc98a1311f4; probe-app.cjs 2bee2355419a51695ee67d597a360618459b9706a1db0771db56add799396b22; rewardkit-stub.py f6dd2d34ac8ec30e452d142f057e23df8fd00e358243a5261f4acb2453dcaa0f. The historical fixture is reused only for unchanged isolation code: current tests/test.sh SHA256 bd68259276ca4b034654efc8a1723a4e702ed62dbe590af6201565f43eabe5aa, tests/Dockerfile 72998ab8ef0e4225e63b88fccdb754943c54022e25da355035efe7f759a55fdd, environment/Dockerfile 0a75419e9598ded9317b26bbf0d2b12de0b9b11185fb4c9fed1ca7f3e52467d1, task.toml cdaa31a87a3a5ec9539552049244c68b09aa5593903b6c32bde8269e2a893c40, scoring.toml and both shared tools all match its recorded source hashes. These harness files also match the frozen template. Old criterion/golden contents are not treated as current grade evidence. Positive current-image evidence: r2 evidence/16/image-boundary.json SHA256 b80fe0e4732c877cf0dd15e3693ad3926faa214ef5e11030be63f4ccebe80555 matches the index; all four expected environment source hashes match current frozen bytes, /app contains only .git/.gitkeep, and /tests and /solution are absent. environment/Dockerfile:9-15 installs only app dependencies and copies public instructions/assets, while verifier-only tooling is installed by tests/Dockerfile:16-31. Conforming alternative: an ordinary-file Node app can use the provided dependencies, read ordinary assets, and write DB_PATH without acquiring test/reward access; the local positive control demonstrates that this boundary does not itself prevent those required operations. Broken alternative: an app arriving with /assets -> /tests can inspect the private finite probes and adapt behavior to them despite incomplete general product functionality. The fixture confirms reading only, not a higher configured grade. Artifact export/import preservation of a root symlink was not executed; no hosted exploit, Oracle/model result, or configured grade is asserted. This uncertainty keeps risk=true and the run verdict PARTIAL rather than allowing clearance.
counterexample: Transfer /assets as a symlink to /tests alongside an ordinary /app/server.js. The actual shared test.sh follows that command-line symlink during chmod -R a+rX /assets, allowing the UID-65534 submission process to read private judge.toml files. The hash-bound local fixture reproduces that read with successful SQLite operation as a control; whether hosted artifact transport preserves the root link remains unmeasured.
suggested_fix: Obtain an approved shared-harness or artifact-transfer correction that rejects symlinked artifact roots before permission changes and keeps /tests private, then test ordinary files and the /assets -> /tests case through the actual transfer path; preserve current template files until that shared change is authorized.
